blocks.text: Jab barish ke paani ka pH 5.6 se kam ho to use acid rain kehte hain; is mein har qism ki barsaat (precipitation) shamil hai: barish, barf (snow), sleet (barf mili barish) ya ole (hail). Fossil fuels jalne se SOₓ aur NOₓ atmosphere mein aati hain. Yeh gases hawa ki nami (moisture) se mil kar acids banati hain. Hawa in tezabi qatron ko bohat door tak le ja sakti hai. Aakhir yeh qatre acid rain, tezabi ole, barf aur yahan tak ke dhund (fog) ki shakal mein zameen par wapas aate hain. Acid rain dekhne, chhoone aur chakhne mein saaf barish jaisi hi hoti hai, lekin is ki corrosive (cheezon ko gala dene wali) fitrat environment ko bohat nuqsan deti hai. Sab se aham chemical reactions yeh hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'pH less than 5-6' chhapa hai. Sahi had pH 5.6 hai: saaf barish bhi CO₂ ghulne se halki tezabi (pH taqreeban 5.6) hoti hai, aur is se kam pH wali barish acid rain kehlati hai.
Fossil fuels se nikli SO₂ oxidise ho kar SO₃ banti hai, jo phir paani se react kar ke sulphuric acid banati hai.
Nitrogen ka oxide paani se react kar ke nitric acid aur nitrous acid banata hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne yeh equation NO(g) + H₂O(ℓ) → HNO₃(aq) + HNO₂(aq) chhapi hai, jo balanced nahi. Paani se yeh do acids nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) banati hai: 2NO₂(g) + H₂O(ℓ) → HNO₃(aq) + HNO₂(aq).

blocks.prompt: Acid rain banne ke bare chemical steps kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Fuel jalne se nikli SO₂ hawa mein SO₃ banti hai (2SO₂ + O₂ → 2SO₃), aur SO₃ paani ke qatron mein ghul kar sulphuric acid deti hai (SO₃ + H₂O → H₂SO₄). NO₂ paani se nitric aur nitrous acids deti hai (2NO₂ + H₂O → HNO₃ + HNO₂). Yeh acids 5.6 se kam pH wali barish, barf ya dhund ki shakal mein girte hain.

items: Acid rain: pH 5.6 se kam; fossil fuels ki SOₓ aur NOₓ nami se mil kar acids banati hain; hawa door tak le jati hai.
2SO₂ + O₂ → 2SO₃; SO₃ + H₂O → H₂SO₄; 2NO₂ + H₂O → HNO₃ + HNO₂.
